body.message:
As per your request, please find below the 3-month rates for the 2-bedroom apartment at MAG318, Business Bay:

• September: AED 15,000
• October: AED 20,000
• November: AED 23,500

A security deposit of AED 2,000 is required.

Please note that the booking will be calculated on a monthly basis, with each month considered as 30 nights.

The rate displayed on our website is applicable only for the September period. Rates may vary from month to month depending on availability and demand. Therefore, the rates applicable to your requested period are as mentioned above.

*
Long-Term Booking Terms:
*
To confirm and secure a 3-month or 6-month booking, the first month's rent, last month's rent, and security deposit are required to be paid in advance. Once the required payment is received, we will be able to reserve the apartment and secure the agreed rate for the confirmed booking period.

Thank you, and please let us know if you would like to proceed.
